name: Xeri
description: Xeri (Ξερή, 'dry') is a popular Greek fishing card game. 2 or 4 players. 52 cards. 6 each + 4 face-up on table. Match rank to capture entire pile. Jack captures any pile. 'Xeri' = capturing lone card (10pts bonus, Jack Xeri = 20pts). Score: most cards=3pts, A/K/Q/J/10=1pt each, 10♦=1pt extra, 2♣=1pt.

history.origins: Xeri (from Greek ξερή, meaning dry or plain) is a well-known Greek card game in which players capture the play pile by matching its top card. Play is similar to the Turkish game Pişti though scoring differs; the xeri (capturing a lone card) idea also appears in Kontsina and in Diloti. Documented from Greek contributors and widely played in Greece.
timeline: 20th century: Widely played in Greece as a traditional fishing game.
history.cultural: One of Greece's most popular card games.

setup.dealing: 6 each + 4 face-up center. Redeal 6 when hands empty.

rules.objective: Collect the most points by capturing cards from the table; win each round by scoring the majority of points (cards, face values, good 10, good 2, and xeri bonuses).
rules.gameplay: Play card. Match rank = capture entire pile. Jack = capture any pile. Xeri = capture lone card (bonus 10pts; Jack Xeri = 20pts). Redeal 6 when hands empty. Last capturer gets remaining cards.

variations.name: Four players
variations.description: Played by four in partnerships, partners opposite; direction of play anticlockwise; opponent to dealer's left cuts, opponent to dealer's right leads.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Partnership and player-count variant; no engine constant overrides defined for 4p.

variations.name: Point scoring to 151
variations.description: Instead of counting games won, keep cumulative points; first player or team to reach 151 or more at end of a round wins; if both reach 151 in same round, play to 251.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Scoring variant only; target score would need scoring.targetScore override.

scoring.description: Most cards=3pts. Each A,K,Q,J,10=1pt. 10♦=extra 1pt. 2♣=1pt. Xeri=10pts. Jack Xeri=20pts. Play to 151.
